name: Financial Datasets
long_description:
Financial Datasets gives agents access to real-time global financial data.

We index financial data directly from primary sources and make it available through fast, predictable APIs built for machines.

Earnings, news, fundamentals, KPIs, and more. All searchable within seconds of publication.

We're building the default data layer for financial agents doing research at scale.
one_liner: Connect your agent to the stock market
